$comment: Third-party assets shipped by Céntrate (PROMPT.md § 11, Legal: CC0 or OFL only, listed here). One entry per asset. Add yours when a module bundles a new font, icon set, image, sound or model. Exceptions to CC0/OFL are recorded in DECISIONS.md.

assets.name: Lucide

additionalLicenses.appliesTo: Icons derived from Feather, listed in node_modules/lucide-react/LICENSE (among those used here: lock, clock, check, monitor, smartphone).

usedBy: apps/web/src/components/AppWindow.astro (inline SVG paths, same shapes as lucide-react 1.48.0)
apps/desktop/package.json (lucide-react dependency for the app's icons)

assets.name: Céntrate brand mark and mascot
assets.source: original work of the Céntrate project, drawn by hand as SVG (no third-party, Apple, G-Helper or brand shapes)
assets.colors: packages/shared/src/design/tokens.ts (colors.light.blue plate, colors.light.tile mark; the mascot uses currentColor)
files: assets/brand/icon.svg (app icon master: .icns, .ico, Linux PNG, favicon)
assets/brand/icon-mono.svg (monochrome template: macOS menu bar, idle tray glyph)
assets.generated: Every PNG, .ico and .icns made from these masters (marketing-assets.yml, tray and extension icon generators) is covered by this entry.

generatedFiles.generator: scripts/gen-app-icons.mjs (npm run gen:icons; --check for CI freshness). Rendered with @resvg/resvg-js; .ico and .icns containers written in plain JS.
files: apps/desktop/build/icon.icns (macOS, 1024 canvas with margin; PNG entries ic07-ic14)
apps/desktop/build/icon.ico (Windows, cropped to the plate; PNG entries 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 128, 256)

generatedFiles.generator: by hand, no script: the masters' paths unchanged, comments stripped. Header files add vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" (1.75 px at any size, like lucide's absoluteStrokeWidth); -large files use stroke-width 1.25 (docs/brand.md «Mascota»). No colors: currentColor, painted with tokens through a CSS mask.

usedBy: apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml (buildResources: icon.icns, icon.ico and icons/ are picked up by name)

assets.name: Céntrate achievement badges
assets.source: original work of the Céntrate project, drawn by hand as SVG on the 24 grid with lucide's conventions (stroke 1.75, round caps and joins) but no lucide path data; the frame is the brand ring of assets/brand/icon-mono.svg (closed when earned, 80° gap when pending). No third-party, Apple, G-Helper or brand shapes.
assets.colors: none in the files (currentColor); painted through a CSS mask with packages/shared/src/design/tokens.ts (green when earned, fgMuted while pending)
